notes.title: Stair issues - First update coming soon!
notes.notes:
We are working on STS first update.

Some people are having problems using stairs, especially when going down. This issue waste precious seconds to save the inhabtants. Please, do not be angry with us. :(

So, we are thinking about a better way to "stairs using" and it will be released in the next update.

Thanks for playing STS
